notes.title: Build 50 - Slovak Language Update
notes.notes: [p][b]Einstein's Cats is now fully playable in Slovak, thanks to Martin Szórád (Szodrax)![/b] [/p][p]You can switch the in-game language to Slovak using the Settings screen, which is accessed on the main menu.[/p]

notes.title: Build 43 - Japanese Language Update
notes.notes:
[b]Einstein's Cats is now fully playable in Japanese, thanks to the awesome volunteer translator Hiroshi Ashida.[/b]

You can switch the in-game language to Japanese using the Settings screen, which is accessed on the main menu.

[b]Other updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]Attempted a fix for the "can't grab a nametag" issue.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 41 - Korean Language Update
notes.notes:
Einstein's Cats is now fully playable in Korean, thanks to the talented translators at Minimap!

You can switch the in-game language to Korean using the Settings screen, which is accessed on the main menu.
